Example B: a clipped neighbouring column, a paragraph with inline maths, and footnote 1. Example B: the table of the `block-table-caption-excluded` sample — one Table, one Caption, one Text. ## Related - [Elements](03-output-model-elements.html)§3.1 — how each class is rendered in Markdown - [Block Boundaries](05-layout-block-boundaries.html)§5.2 — where a Picture or Table stops - [Document Type](04-document-level-document-type.html)§4.4 — which sheet is the cover, and so where Title may appear - [Recurring Page Furniture](04-document-level-recurring-page-furniture.html)§4.6 — Page-header and Page-footer decided once for the document - [Heading Depth Across Pages](04-document-level-heading-depth-across-pages.html)§4.5 — the depth a Section-header gets once its class is settled Skill text for this ruleGenerator skill- Give every element exactly one class, shared by its layout and Markdown representations: Text, Title, Section-header, List-item, Caption, Footnote, Page-header, Page-footer, Picture, Table, Formula, Checkbox-Selected, Checkbox-Unselected, Code, Document Index, Form, Key-Value Region. - Title only for the document's own title on its cover; authors, dates and addresses there are Text. - A caption names or explains an object; a footnote adds a source or note; nearby prose is Text. A regular grid is a Table; irregular entry fields are a Form; a small label/value group without a grid is a Key-Value Region. - One List-item per item including its marker and continuation lines; a Formula includes its equation number; a checkbox box covers only the mark, never its label. - Top/bottom margin content is Page-header/Page-footer; widely separated parts of a band are separate elements; a lone page number is a Page-footer.Checker skill- FAIL (MUST) if a Title element appears anywhere other than the document's cover title, or front-matter authors/dates/addresses are merged into the Title. - FAIL (MUST) if a Formula's displayed equation number is outside its Formula element, or a List-item's continuation lines are split from it. - FAIL (MUST) if a checkbox box includes its label text. - FAIL (MUST) if an element carries more than one class or none, or its layout class differs from the corresponding Markdown element's class. - WARN (SHOULD) if ordinary prose next to a figure or table is classed Caption, or a source note is classed Caption instead of Footnote.
